scope: Public RLinf workflow, self-trained initialization; not the unreleased 48.8% to 66.5% run

sft.checkpoint_selection: Fixed step 1000, declared before evaluation; original few-shot budget was not published

value.checkpoint_selection: Fixed step 18000; a finite local protocol choice, not an assertion of the published stopping rule

policy.checkpoint_selection: Final step in the public CFG template

evaluation.selection: No checkpoint selection on final environment evaluation
evaluation.policy_rng: Pinned rollout worker does not explicitly seed policy noise; seeds here identify the environment. Preserve upstream behavior; no bitwise paired-noise claim.
evaluation.reset_state_reuse: Each seed traverses the 50 official states once. The two seeds reuse the same pool; pinned is_eval skips duplicate completions within a seed.

data.sft_tasks: All 10 released tasks, 30 episodes; do not reinterpret SFT task_index 0 as evaluation Task 0
data.rollout_behavior: Authors' released 4096 episodes, not collected by this self-trained initialization
data.critic_validation: Held-out 64 episodes; never used for policy training or final success rate
data.sampling_semantics: Raw weights [1,1] with upstream balance enabled; probabilities are proportional to dataset frame counts, not a 50/50 dataset mixture.

hardware.fsdp: Public no_shard backend, selective BF16; full policy parameters trainable
hardware.checkpoint_io: Save final checkpoint per stage to bound disk use; optimizer/scheduler state retained
hardware.backend_conversion: Native SFT vs legacy CFG: upstream erf/tanh GELU and RoPE floating-point implementations differ. Diagnose without production patches; compare unchanged CFG unconditional vs unchanged CFG positive, native evaluation separately. No original-output equivalence claim.
